player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Admiral Twk''') posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in May 2001.
description: a.k.a.: But I Want to go to Tosche station Deck was undefeated until States, but the record is 22-1, 10 of those tourny games.
cards: posted: Your Insight Serves You Well
notes: Posted 28 May 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Title 'SC States Champion light 2001'; the description says the deck was undefeated until States with a 22-1 record (10 tournament games). Taken as 1st at the 2001 South Carolina State Championship (no wiki page yet).

No objective; starting cards as posted under 'Starting5': Tatooine: Tosche Station, HFTMF, Insurrection, Squadron Assignments, Staging Areas; these count toward the 60. Three Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty. Staging Areas and Your Insight Serves You Well are posted as separate Death Star II Effects (the combo card is later).

Posted 'EndorDB' dested the Light Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay); 'CCDB' dested Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay), the only Light Cloud City docking bay (East Platform is a Dark card); 'TatooineDB' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; 'Jedi Luke' Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Leia with gun' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Han with gun' Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'X-Wing Lasers' X-wing Laser Cannon; 'Obi's journal' Obi-Wan's Journal; 'SATM/Blaster Proficiency' Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency; 'Green 3' Green Squadron 3; 'Red Sq. 1' Red Squadron 1.
Section counts as posted: Interrupts16 (17 listed), Characters17, Starting5, Locations3, Ships6, Weapons5, Effects6. Total is 59 as published (kept as posted).
player_note: Brad Reinhold says this is not, card for card, what he took to States: he made last-minute changes he cannot recall, and remembers subbing in two Weapon Levitations, a Jedi Presence, Courage Of A Skywalker and Glancing Blow.
